d: In this moment from ‘Select Conversations with Tisca Chopra’, Manish Malhotra reflects on some of the early milestones in his journey in cinema. He shares how he first met the legendary Sridevi, worked with her on ‘Gumrah’, and later went on to collaborate with the iconic Rekha. Through these memories, he offers a glimpse into the experiences and relationships that shaped his career in the film industry.
